decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the core hearing-care offer, this earmold variant is still too early to judge and is relatively cheap to keep as an option while market feedback accumulates.
Its dedicated product page and clear launch positioning suggest active commercialization in a familiar product area, so keeping it preserves upside while uncertainty about demand is still resolving.

A vacuum thermoforming unit fits the firm’s established equipment and workflow portfolio, and in a growing industry it is sensible to keep this adjacent product on the market until clearer evidence of weak value appears.
